verdicts.proof: Old: sos_service_screen.dart:222 shows the Done button only if _uploaded. v2: SosServiceScreen.build (sos_service_screen.dart:118-126) passes the same _uploaded flag and _done handler; sos_service_view_v2.dart:64 puts the dock CTA in only when uploaded. The only route to this screen is /sos/service (router.dart:492-493), so every entry point (sos_report_screen.dart:260, :279) lands on the same state. As in the old look, nothing explains why the button is missing; the upload step shows the 'invoice uploaded' tick once it is done (view_v2:39-48).

Old: _uploadInvoice sos_service_screen.dart:58-106 (error dialog with Settings only if fe.needsSettings, Messages, Retry). v2: view_v2:50 upload button onTap=onUpload, wired to the same _uploadInvoice at sos_service_screen.dart:124; there is no other upload path in v2 (grep uploadServiceInvoice: only sos_provider.dart:395 and this screen). The same showErrorDialog is used. 70a94933 only showed toasts, so both current looks are stronger than 4.1.3.

Old: sos_service_screen.dart:74-77 returns with no upload when the camera is cancelled. v2 calls the same _uploadInvoice (sos_service_screen.dart:124); while uploading, v2 shows SosBusyButtonV2 with no tap (view_v2:37-38), and the old look disables the button (loading ? null, :287). Note that _ensureIncident (:65) runs before the picker, so a cancel after the incident was created still leaves the incident in place; this is the same in both looks.

Old: sos_replacement_screen.dart:172 watches sosReplacementMotosProvider (sos_replacement_motos.dart:39-54 = candidates filter :20-23 + motoAvailableForRange). v2: the same motosAsync is passed at :174-175; view_v2:59-80 lists exactly that list, with no other source. All v2 entry points go through Routes.sosReplacement to the same SosReplacementScreen: shell_actions.dart:30 (pending-SOS FAB/strip), sos_detail_screen.dart:338/:473, sos_theft_screen.dart:73, sos_immobile_screen.dart:59 and sos_breakdown_immobile_screen.dart:66 (router.dart:496-497). Server: sos_swap_bookings raises 'not free until end of rental' (20261011c_rpc_owner_admin_checks_b_sos_swap.sql:167-176). 70a94933 listed all bikes from motorcyclesProvider (:99), so the filter is new and applies to both looks. Neither look filters by driving licence.

Old: sos_replacement_screen.dart:245-262 shows an amber note with the phone number and SosCallButton. v2: view_v2:61-67 shows an MgStateBanner warn with the title v2UxAsmNoBikesTitle, the sosNoMotos text and the same SosCallButton (passed at screen:196). The v2 banner does not print the phone number in the text, but the call button dials the line.
Old: sos_replacement_screen.dart:273-279 shows MgErrorView with retry and call. v2: the identical MgErrorView is built at screen:189-195 and rendered by view_v2:88.

verdicts.fix_idea: Optional: in the v2 view, show the dock CTA as visibly inactive (opacity) while selectedId is null, still calling _confirm so that the toast appears.
verdicts.proof: Old: _confirm sos_replacement_screen.dart:86-89 shows the toast selectReplacementMoto. v2: the dock CTA view_v2:101-106 has onTap=widget.onConfirm = the same _confirm (screen:179); it is the only confirm path. The toast is identical. Server: sos_swap_bookings refuses a NULL p_replacement_moto_id (20261011c:167).

Old: _confirm :90-94 with sosDeliveryAddress :30-38 (empty text -> null -> toast). v2 receives the same AddressAutocompleteField with the same _addrKey and callbacks (screen:182-188) and the same SosHereAddress with the same _hereKey (screen:181), so _deliveryAddress reads the same field. Only the hint text differs (v2UxAsmEnterCity). 70a94933 required a picked suggestion; the current rule accepts typed text, and this relaxation applies to both looks equally. The server does not check the address.

Old: sos_replacement_screen.dart:306 sets onPressed to _loading ? null : _confirm and shows a spinner (:308-309); 70a94933:193 had the same. v2: busy: widget.loading (view_v2:104) -> SosNeonButtonV2 MgPress onTap: busy ? null : onTap (sos_actions_v2.dart:66), with a spinner at :78-80. _confirm itself has no re-entry guard in either look. Server: double_swap_protection in sos_swap_bookings (20261011c:130,153).

Old: _confirm :98-113 (no active incident or load error -> showSosActionFailed with noActiveIncident / eoSosReplaceByPhone, retry). v2 uses the same _confirm (screen:179). The pending-SOS shortcut shell_actions.dart:29-31 only pushes the route; it existed in 70a94933 too (app_shell.dart:744). Server: sos_swap_bookings refuses resolved/closed incidents (20261011c:41) and checks the owner.

Old: :129-140 isSosMotoTakenError (sos_replacement_motos.dart:28-29) clears the selection, invalidates the provider and calls showErrorDialog 'pick other'. v2 uses the same _confirm; the selection is read back through selectedId (screen:176), so the cleared selection is reflected, and the reloaded list comes through the same motosAsync. The dialog is the shared showErrorDialog.
Old: :141-146 handles any other failure with showSosActionFailed (phone / retry); :159-166 shows success only after the RPC and the sosDone route. v2 uses the same _confirm, so the code is identical.

Old: :118-125 sends p_delivery_fee 0, p_daily_price 0 and p_is_free true. The v2 path calls the same _confirm, so the parameters are identical; the v2 header view_v2:92-99 shows the title replacementFree, and each bike row has a 'free' pill (:187-191). Server: sos_swap_bookings forces p_is_free true and zero prices for customers (20261011c:45).
